title: Coding with GitHub Copilot
summary: A training I delivered for Philips University.

feedback.themes: Participants most often valued clear explanations and relevance to daily work. Suggestions centered on more hands-on practice.
quotes: Clearly instruction or advice is: Don't give bigger context to get best result. always minimize the context and get best out of it. Co-pilot means helper and not main person to implement.
This will give me a very good start to my co-pilot journey. Thank you.
